notes.title: アップデート：不具合修正
notes.content:
Bug fixes

・If you press "Start from the beginning of the stage" just before the game is over, the novel will be carried over and the game will be over even after restarting.

Chat

It's been a month since the release.

Thanks to you, we have received "good reviews" on the store page.

We are also happy to see comments on streaming and SNS.

There are only a few bugs, so I think it will be a while before we get any updates.

(This means you can start working on the next game with peace of mind.)

Thank you for your continued support.

Kyuko

notes.title: Announcement of the Release of "Madoromi Travel"!
notes.content:
The title "魔女の脳" is an 旧古 one. "まどろみトラベル" has been released.

With the release, you can purchase it at a 15% discount for a while.
Wouldn't it be fun to have a Golden Week where you fight against drowsiness for about 1 or 2 hours?

Distribution, etc.
Feel free to distribute and create gameplay videos, including monetization.

Bugs, etc.
Please report any bugs or issues here:
https://twitter.com/kyuko4437

If you enjoyed it
It seems that if you could leave a review, it would be more likely to be featured in the store's recommendations.
If you have the time, I would be delighted if you could write one.
